title: Borel image and null-set pullback along a bi-Lipschitz piece
statement: Let F : ℝ^n → ℝ^P be L-Lipschitz, B ⊆ ℝ^n Borel and m > 0 with m|a − a'| ≤ |F(a) − F(a')| for all a, a' ∈ B. Then F(B) is Borel. Moreover, for every predicate p on ℝ^P that holds H^n⌞F(B)-a.e. (H^n = μHE[n]), p(F(b)) holds for Lebesgue-a.e. b ∈ B, i.e. (volume.restrict B)-a.e.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), LipschitzWith L F → MeasurableSet B → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖F a - F a'‖) → MeasurableSet (F '' B) ∧ ∀ p : Euclid P → Prop, (∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n].restrict (F '' B)), p y) → ∀ᵐ b ∂(volume.restrict B), p (F b)
